femclothes.tinturas.aviso.salida_ocupada: Take the finished garment out of the Output slot first

femclothes.elegir_cuerpo.tooltip.siempre: Yes: the chosen body, with its underwear, always shows, even without mod clothes. No: it only shows under mod clothes.
femclothes.elegir_cuerpo.tooltip.zona.in: Underwear color: click, then pick it with the palette or sliders
femclothes.muestra.ayuda: Dye Station: "Use sample" copies this color. Not consumed.

femclothes.muestra.sin_muestra: Hold a color sample on the cursor or keep one in your inventory

femclothes.tinturas.tooltip.usar_muestra: Copies the sample on the cursor (or the first in your inventory) into the color you are editing
femclothes.maniqui.sin_lugar: The mannequin has no room left for that garment
femclothes.chaqueta.tooltip.capucha: Hood: %s to put it up or down

femclothes.tinturas.tooltip.distancia_v: Vertical spacing between motifs (or horizontal stripes): 50% touching, 300% triple

femclothes.slot.piernas.exterior: Pants and skirts. Worn over socks.
femclothes.slot.socks.pair: Socks. Worn under pants and skirts.
femclothes.slot.arms.armwarmer: Arm warmers. Worn under the shirt sleeve. (Opens from the offhand slot.)
femclothes.slot.espalda.capa: Mod cape: replaces your skin cape; hidden with elytra. Hood: %s (Opens from the chestplate slot.)
femclothes.slot.lugares: %s slots: you can wear several at once, layered
femclothes.slot.maquinas: Cut, dyed and printed in the mod machines
femclothes.aplique.molde.tooltip: Appliqué shape for the Styling Table (not consumed)
femclothes.aplique.retazo.tooltip: One is used per appliqué; returned when removed

femclothes.estilado.tooltip.quitar: Remove the selected appliqué and get its scrap back

femclothes.elegir_cuerpo.tooltip.volumen: Body and cloth volume: rounded (smooth surface), voxel (fine blocks) or chunky voxel (1 px blocks), like the square bust.
femclothes.sublimadora.tooltip.escanear: Pick an image from your computer: it becomes a Camerapture picture (uses 1 paper from the tank) and goes to Front; if Front already has a picture, to Back.
femclothes.sublimadora.escanear.sin_pape: The Sublimator needs paper to scan.
femclothes.sublimadora.escanear.no_image: That file is not a readable image.
femclothes.sublimadora.mascara.ayuda: Goes in the Sublimator's mask slot: the picture is printed only inside this shape. Not consumed.

femclothes.sublimadora.tooltip.capa_subi: Moves the selected layer up (painted on top).

femclothes.sublimadora.capa_llena: There are already 12 layers: delete one to fix another.

femclothes.estilado.tooltip.obj_inclinar: Tilt the object forward / back (15° steps)

femclothes.estilado.tooltip.biblioteca_d: Get a copy of this template
femclothes.estilado.tooltip.biblioteca_b: Remove it from the list (does not touch the ones you already took)
femclothes.estilado.panel.biblioteca_vac: This table has not made any templates yet. Pick an applique and use Create template.
femclothes.moldes.vacio: You have not made any applique templates yet.
femclothes.moldes.vacio_de: %s has not made any applique templates.
femclothes.moldes.sin_autor: There are no templates by a player named %s.
femclothes.estilado.panel.ninguno: Select an appliqué from the list (or place a new one) to adjust how it sits and moves.
femclothes.estilado.panel.cara_modelo: Mod models always rest on their back
femclothes.estilado.tooltip.cara_base: Which face of the object rests on the garment: its center is the reference point, and rotation and size pivot from it

femclothes.estilado.tooltip.amplitud: How wide the swing opens, in degrees

femclothes.estilado.tooltip.restablecer: Resets placement and motion to defaults (the resting face is kept)
femclothes.aplique.molde_personalizado.a: Goes in the mould slot of the Styling Table: nothing is used up. It can be renamed at an anvil.
femclothes.estilado.tooltip.crear_molde: Makes an appliqué mould from the selected appliqué (object or model, placement and motion) for use in the normal Styling Table
femclothes.modelado.creativa.sin_lugar: The creative Shaper had no room for %s mold(s): %s. The storage needs to be bigger.
femclothes.maniqui.skin.nombre_invalido: That player name is not valid
femclothes.estilado.tooltip.modo_color: Switch between placing appliques and painting the hat's 3 zones with the scrap's colors
femclothes.estilado.tooltip.color_zona: Copies this scrap color to this zone of the hat (the scrap is not used up)
femclothes.estilado.tooltip.color_entero: Copies the scrap's 3 colors to the hat's 3 zones
femclothes.estilado.ayuda_color: Click the brim, cone or band of the hat: it takes the color %s (change it with the buttons)
femclothes.estilado.tooltip.patron_zona: Changes this hat zone's pattern (painted with its color and a contrast tone)

femclothes.slot.head.choker: Chokers. Worn at the base of the neck. You can hang pendants (appliqués) on them in the Styling Table.
femclothes.correa.molde.ayuda: Used in the Styling Table, in Straps mode: two clicks on the garment (start and end).
femclothes.correa.tooltip.largo: Length of the hanging chain, 2 to 32 px in steps of 2 (Anchored and Draped only)

femclothes.correa.tooltip.quitar: Removes the last strap (or cancels the start point after the first click)
femclothes.correa.aviso.molde: Put a strap template in the template slot
femclothes.correa.aviso.lleno: This garment already has the maximum number of straps
femclothes.correa.aviso.parte: Both points must be on the same body part
femclothes.correa.ayuda.inicio: Click the garment: start of the strap
femclothes.correa.ayuda.fin: Click the garment: end of the strap (the yellow guide shows the path)
femclothes.correa.tooltip.lista: Pick one of the garment's straps: Mode and Width change it, Recolor gives it the scrap's colors and Remove takes it off
femclothes.correa.tooltip.recolorear: Gives the chosen strap the scrap's 3 colors (not consumed)

femclothes.pollera.molde_borde.ayuda: Goes in the Skirt's Custom pin: changes the hem edge.

femclothes.estilado.tooltip.pestana.1: Straps: ribbons, chains and cords between two points or hanging from one
femclothes.estilado.tooltip.pestana.2: Finish: fabric texture, trim with material and zone colors

femclothes.estilado.ayuda_acabado: Put in the template and the material, then press the finish button.
femclothes.telar.tooltip.prenda: Tick the garments you want. They are woven one at a time, in order. Uses %s wool and %s thread.
femclothes.telar.tooltip.reiniciar: Restart the batch with the same amount
